Support Bot: Promo redemption webhook accepted (200). webhook_id=wh_03a2f, account_id=acct_6Xz, promo_code=SPRINGLAUNCH2026, trace=tx-9b8c. Customer reports UI shows green check but balance = $0.00 :eyes:
Sam W: pulling case 48219 — customer says code redeemed via UI and email confirmation received. sending repro steps and API logs.
Sam W: Repro steps I used:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx' \n  -d '{"account_id":"acct_6Xz","code":"SPRINGLAUNCH2026"}'
```
Sam W: API response:
```json
{"status":"accepted","grant_id":"grant_77a","grant_type":"invoice_credit","amount_cents":50000,"applied_to":"billing_account:b_82"}
```
Sam W: So response explicitly says invoice_credit applied to billing_account:b_82 — but customer expected a spendable token-credit visible in the org balance.
Jordan L: :thinking_face: That explains it — grants-service created an invoice_credit (reduces invoices) rather than a usage credit. We have two code paths: invoice_credit vs usage_credit. Usually promos for trial use usage_credit for hosted API balance. Any idea why this account got invoice_credit?
Ana G: I pulled the grant row: grant_id=grant_77a, promo_id=promo_spring2026, target_type=billing_account, target_id=b_82, created_by=promos-webhook, created_at=2026-03-16T14:02:11Z. The billing_account b_82 is the "paying account" for that org — account configuration shows billing_mode=invoice. Our promos rules map to invoice_credit when billing_mode != "prepaid".
Sam W: So customer redeemed successfully, but they don't see spendable balance because their org is on invoice billing and receives an invoice credit instead. Customer expected trial credits (prepaid) — mismatch in expectations.
Jordan L: Quick remediation options:
- If customer needs spendable credits, we can create a usage_credit grant for acct_6Xz (usage bucket) and reverse the invoice_credit.
- Or explain invoice credit behavior and apply an equivalent usage credit if they insist.
Ana G: I'll prepare a remediation script. Runbook (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/promos/remap-invoice-to-usage (requires BillingOps perms). Proposed one-off command pattern:
```sql
-- create usage credit row and mark original grant reversed
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO usage_credits (id, account_id, amount_cents, created_by, meta) VALUES ('uc_manual_20260316','acct_6Xz',50000,'billing_ops','promo:SPRINGLAUNCH2026');
UPDATE grants SET status='reversed', reversal_note='converted to usage_credit by BillingOps' WHERE id='grant_77a';
COMMIT;
```
Ana G: I'll need BillingOps signoff and a ticket to run the change in prod. tagging @BillingOps for approval.
BillingOps: ACK, we need ledger_id and original webhook payload for audit. also confirm customer X-ray (sensitivity) level.
Sam W: ledger_id from webhook: ledger_tx_20260316_5f3. Attached full webhook payload in case file. Customer notified: "we're investigating, will update in 24 hrs" :+1:
Jordan L: For a long-term fix we should update promo routing to prefer usage_credit when promo is trial-type regardless of billing_mode OR add clearer UX language for invoice vs usage credits. I'll open an eng ticket.
Ana G: Escalation plan: 1) Create usage credit and reverse invoice credit (manual) 2) Confirm account balance reflects credits 3) Close case with explanation + doc update. ETA for manual change: 6-12 hours after BillingOps runs script.
Sam W: Thanks team — escalating to BillingOps. I'll update case 48219 with the remediation timeline and keep customer posted. :raised_hands:
